integrity: Self-contained analytic proof supplemented by reproducible finite computations. The motivating algorithm and its previously proposed alignment safeguard are credited. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only on symmetric 2-by-2 rank-one tangent gradients with positive parameters and unguarded projected-polar iterates. No general optimizer convergence claim; spectral-norm feasibility is not asserted for the raw iterates.
title: Sharp alignment decay in rank-one tangent-polar refinement
